detail: Final rule published 02-Nov-2026, effective 07-Dec-2026, all DA 40s. AFM temporary revision plus initial door/safety-hook inspection, handle-force measurement and placards per MSB 40-103 Rev 2; possible gas-spring replacement. 100 hr TIS or 100 days after effective date, whichever first. The 22-Mar-2027 annual is too late. Estimate (FAA tables + MSB II.3): 3 hr and ~$76 parts if it passes; up to 12 hr and ~$1,436 parts if gas spring, hook, retaining block, guide blocks and sealant are all replaced. WI step 20(g) cites 'RSB 40-093' — a typo for RSB 40-083 / D4-105 / 40NG-053 (companion numbers match; SB 40-093 is baggage nets). RSB 40-083 (Recommended, 2017) replaces the steel pin of the canopy and passenger door handle gas-spring mechanisms: 2 hr per door, applies to S/N 40.561–40.1206 (includes 40.922); no compliance record found.
action: Wayne looking at Absolute Aero (Hayward, Diamond Service Center). MSB allows any certified mechanic; a DSC is needed only for warranty credit, but helps if a 'contact Diamond' finding comes up. Ask the shop: which latch version 40.922 has (MÄM 40-139 or older), whether RSB 40-083 was ever done, and a quote to do it concurrently (~4 hr, both doors). Work to MSB Rev 2 before 07-Dec counts. Insert the AFM TR and log it.
